announcements.headline: Amundi Asset Management: NOTICE TO SHAREHOLDE...
announcements.insight: Amundi Asset Management issued a notice to shareholders following the August delisting of UCITS ETF share classes. Shareholders should monitor for further procedural updates regarding these listings.

announcements.headline: Amundi Asset Management: Delisting of 26 UCITS ETF Share Classes from London Stock Exchange
announcements.insight: Amundi Asset Management is delisting 26 UCITS ETF share classes from the London Stock Exchange. This administrative action affects specific fund products rather than the parent company's core operations.

announcements.headline: Amundi Asset Management: Delisting of 26 UCITS ETF Share Classes from London Stock Exchange
announcements.insight: Amundi Asset Management is delisting 26 UCITS ETF Share Classes from the London Stock Exchange. This administrative action affects specific fund products rather than LYXOR INTERNATIONAL ASSET MANAGEMENT (DJEL) directly.
